# Player at (16, 31). Small boat at [[15, 19], [15, 22], [16, 21], [16, 20]].
# Need LEFT 5 to reach col 21.

result = action(['LEFT'] * 5)
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
player = [n for n in seg if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] == 1]
print(f"Player: {[(n['boundary']) for n in player]}")
print(f"Game over: {result.get('game_over', False)}")

if not result.get('game_over', False):
    # Check adjacency to small boat
    adj = current_frame.segmentation['adjacency_list']
    player_id = [n['id'] for n in seg if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] == 1][0]
    player_adj = [j if i == player_id else i for i, j in adj if player_id in [i, j]]
    print(f"\nPlayer adjacents:")
    for adj_id in player_adj:
        adj_node = seg[adj_id]
        if adj_node['pixels'] < 100:
            print(f"  color={adj_node['color']}, pixels={adj_node['pixels']}, boundary={adj_node['boundary']}")
    
    # Check small boats
    small_boats = [n for n in seg if n['color'] == 'S' and n['pixels'] == 6]
    print(f"\nSmall boats:")
    for sb in small_boats:
        print(f"  boundary={sb['boundary']}")
    
    # Try SPACE to interact
    print(f"\nTrying SPACE...")
    result2 = action(['SPACE'])
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    player2 = [n for n in seg2 if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] == 1]
    print(f"After SPACE: player at {[(n['boundary']) for n in player2]}")
    print(f"Game over: {result2.get('game_over', False)}")
    
    # Check what changed
    small_boats2 = [n for n in seg2 if n['color'] == 'S' and n['pixels'] == 6]
    print(f"Small boats after SPACE:")
    for sb in small_boats2:
        print(f"  boundary={sb['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
